displayName: Minimum and Maximum Quantity for WooCommerce

dataLocation.evidence: Plugin source: rules are posts of the wc_mmqw custom post type with their settings in post meta; no remote calls or vendor account.

pitfalls.summary: Per-product and per-category min/max quantity rules have no native Wix target chosen yet, so they are pending. VERIFIED IN PLUGIN SOURCE 2.1.1 (admin/class-min-max-quantity-for-woocommerce-admin.php): rules are `wc_mmqw` posts with meta mmqw_rule_groups/mmqw_total_groups; store-wide limits are wp_options rows the bridge cannot read.

quirks: Seen on a live store: plugin inactive, one published wc_mmqw rule left behind.
